Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the foundry as the "Cold Spring Foundry" based solely on the WebSurfer's search results. The WebSurfer explicitly returned the name "West Point Foundry" located in Cold Spring, NY. The Planner failed to correct the name to match the source data ("West Point Foundry" instead of "Cold Spring Foundry") and prematurely concluded the task was complete with the wrong name. The actual historical name of the foundry is the West Point Foundry, even though it is located in the village of Cold Spring.
